NVIDIA Streamline SDK headers, v2.14.16 (https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline, tag v2.14.16),
MIT licence (LICENSE.txt). Only the headers the engine includes (vk_streamline.cpp); unchanged but for one line in sl_pcl.h
(marked bbport: its C++23 branch does not compile).
The runtime DLLs are not in the repository: tools/fetch_streamline.sh downloads them.
